tickets.title: Follow up on missing signature
tickets.text: Use this workflow when a submitted form, agreement, authorization, or disclosure is returned incomplete because one or more required signatures, initials, or dates are missing. Confirm the exact missing items, provide a clean signing path, and document completion before resubmission. Address the missing documentation for Evan Thimblefern’s former-employer 401(k) rollover request at Juniper Jellyfish Benefits: the latest statement and a required signature guarantee page are missing.

subTasks.title: Identify the missing signature items
subTasks.text: Review the returned paperwork or custodian notice and list each missing signature, initial, date, or capacity designation. Note whether wet ink, electronic signature, witness, notary, or spousal consent is required. For Evan’s former-employer 401(k) rollover request, identify the missing Juniper Jellyfish Benefits statement and required signature guarantee page.

subTasks.title: Send corrected signing instructions
subTasks.text: Prepare a concise follow-up message with the affected document name, the specific pages or fields requiring action, acceptable signing method, and how the client should return the completed item.

subTasks.title: Verify completed packet before resubmission
subTasks.text: After receipt, confirm all signature requirements are complete and legible, then resubmit through the appropriate channel and save confirmation in the client record.

tickets.evidence: the latest Juniper Jellyfish Benefits statement and a required signature guarantee page were missing; the unresolved documentation need is dated 2026-08-22.

tickets.title: Coordinate benefits enrollment support
tickets.text: Use this coordination template when a client requests help reviewing employer benefits enrollment options, such as health coverage, HSA or FSA elections, disability coverage, group life insurance, retirement plan deferrals, or voluntary benefits. Keep recommendations within planning scope and document assumptions. Review Evan Thimblefern’s Clockwork Clover Systems annual election choices for health plan, HSA, disability coverage, group life, and 401(k) deferrals before he submits elections.

subTasks.title: Gather enrollment materials from client
subTasks.text: Ask the client for the benefits guide, plan comparison tables, premium costs, employer match details, enrollment portal screenshots if needed, and any questions they want addressed.

subTasks.title: Prepare planning review notes
subTasks.text: Mira Quillwhistle reviews benefit choices for cash-flow impact, retirement contribution opportunities, tax considerations, coverage gaps, and coordination with existing planning assumptions.

subTasks.title: Return decision summary to client
subTasks.text: Provide a plain-language summary of key tradeoffs, items the client must decide directly, and questions to take to the employer benefits administrator or insurer.

subTasks.title: Update planning records after enrollment
subTasks.text: Once the client confirms elections, update planning inputs for premiums, retirement contributions, HSA or FSA amounts, insurance coverage, and employer match assumptions.

tickets.evidence: requested review of health plan, HSA, disability coverage, group life, and 401(k) deferral choices before submitting elections; the agreed review is due 2026-08-31.
